jobs.title: Part-Time Accounts Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Part-Time Accounts Assistant Salary £28k -32k Full-Time Equivalent dependent on skills and experience Leeds City Centre – Office based Part Time, Flexible Working Pattern offered – 20-25 hours per week Yorkshire Design Group is an established, family-owned property business with over 35 years' experience in the development, regeneration and management of commercial property in Leeds. With a varied portfolio of properties and interests across two group companies, we are looking for an experienced Accounts Assistant / Bookkeeper to take responsibility for the day-to-day accounting and financial administration of the business. This is an interesting opportunity for someone who enjoys the variety and responsibility that comes with working within a smaller, established organisation. You will work closely with the company's external accountant while becoming a key point of contact for day-to-day financial matters. Your Role The position covers a broad range of transactional accounts and bookkeeping responsibilities , with particular involvement in the financial administration of our managed properties. Your responsibilities will include, but not limited to: * Maintaining accurate day-to-day accounts across two group companies * Raising sales invoices and processing tenant recharges * Managing purchase ledger and supplier invoices * Monitoring outstanding balances and chasing debtors * Maintaining accurate tenant accounts and financial records * Processing costs associated with landlords, utilities and service charges * Dealing with invoices from contractors and other suppliers * Completing bank reconciliations * Maintaining accounting records within Sage * Investigating and resolving day-to-day accounts queries * Liaising with tenants, suppliers, landlords and contractors where required * Working closely with the external accountant and providing financial information as required * Supporting year-end accounting processes * Assisting with other finance and accounts administration across the group The nature of the business means there will be plenty of variety, and you will have the opportunity to develop a good understanding of both the financial and operational sides of the property portfolio. Our ideal candidate We are looking for someone with solid practical bookkeeping or accounts experience who is confident managing their own workload and maintaining accurate financial records. You should have: * Previous experience as an Accounts Assistant, Bookkeeper or in a similar finance position * Practical experience using Sage * AAT Level 3 * Experience of sales and purchase ledger * Good knowledge of invoicing, reconciliations and credit control * Strong numerical and administrative skills * Good working knowledge of Excel * Excellent attention to detail * The confidence to communicate professionally with tenants, suppliers and other external contacts * The ability to organise and prioritise your own workload Experience within property, construction, commercial property or facilities management would be beneficial, although it is not essential. A Flexible Part-Time Opportunity We recognise that experienced people looking for part-time work often require some flexibility around their working pattern. Our preference is approximately three days per week, although we are equally happy to consider spreading the hours across five shorter days, including a school-hours arrangement. The position is office based at The Calls in Leeds city centre, working as part of a small, established team. About Yorkshire Design Group For more than 35 years, Yorkshire Design Group has been involved in the development and management of property in Leeds, combining property development with the ongoing management of its commercial assets. As a family-owned business, we offer the opportunity to work within a close-knit organisation where you can take genuine responsibility for your area and build a long-term understanding of the business. Interested? Please apply with your updated CV. Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful

jobs.title: Health & Safety Officer - Part Time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Location: Bradford, BD4 Division: Engineering – SWIFT Temps Ltd, Bradford Office Salary: £31,000 – £39,000 per annum pro rata (PAYE) + Holiday Accrual Job Type: Part-Time | 12-Week Temp-to-Perm SWIFT Temps Ltd is currently recruiting on behalf of our valued manufacturing client in Bradford BD4 for an experienced Part-Time Health & Safety Officer. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced H&S professional looking for a flexible part-time position, with working hours potentially suited to those seeking school term-time working arrangements. About the Role Our client is seeking an experienced Health & Safety Officer to join their manufacturing site in Bradford. You will play a key role in promoting a strong Health, Safety and Environmental culture, ensuring compliance with UK legislation and company standards, while providing practical advice and support to the site management team. Ideally, you will have experience within a manufacturing, engineering or machinery-based environment, with a good understanding of PUWER (Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations) and machinery safety. Key Responsibilities * Implement and monitor H&S policies, procedures and risk assessments. * Conduct regular site inspections and H&S audits. * Investigate accidents, incidents and near misses and recommend appropriate corrective actions. * Ensure compliance with current UK H&S legislation and relevant industry standards. * Maintain accurate H&S records, documentation and reports. * Develop and maintain emergency procedures and coordinate emergency drills. * Arrange testing, servicing and maintenance of H&S equipment. * Provide guidance on PPE, machinery safety and safe working practices. * Support the management of PUWER assessments and machinery-related safety requirements . * Lead regular H&S meetings with the site leadership team. * Monitor PPM schedules and ensure inspections, servicing and statutory checks are completed on time. * Identify opportunities for continual improvement in H&S standards and working practices. * Provide practical H&S advice and guidance to employees and management. About You The successful candidate will ideally have: * IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent H&S qualification. * NEBOSH Certificate is preferred but not essential. * Previous experience working in a Health & Safety role, ideally within manufacturing, engineering or a similar environment. * Experience or knowledge of machinery safety and PUWER. * Good knowledge of UK Health & Safety legislation and best practice. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. * Good organisational and problem-solving abilities. * The ability to identify workplace risks and implement practical solutions. * Good IT and Microsoft Office skills. First Aid and Fire Safety qualifications are desirable but not essential. Working Hours & Flexibility * 15–25 hours per week * Flexible working hours available * School term-time working may be considered for the right candidate * Part-time hours to be agreed with the successful applicant and client What's on Offer? £31,000 – £39,000 per annum pro rata Part-time, flexible working Potential school term-time arrangement 12-week temp-to-perm opportunity Free on-site parking Bradford-based manufacturing environment Long-term permanent opportunity for the right candidate Holiday pay accrued separately How to Apply If you are an experienced Health & Safety professional looking for a flexible part-time opportunity within a manufacturing environment, we would be keen to hear from you. Please send your CV to Mcmillan Serrant at SWIFT Temps Ltd – Bradford Office. Phone: (phone number removed) INDBR
